task.description: Implement EE-09 (Variable scoping and merge) per the design in src/design/engine.md (Section EE-09). Key implementation points: (1) Add mergeVariables function in src/engine/instance.zig (or a new src/engine/variables.zig if better scoped) — three-path collision policy: new key=insert, existing key+schema-compatible=overwrite+VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event, existing key+schema-violation=ERROR+EXECUTION_ERROR event; (2) mergeVariables MUST NOT go into transition.zig (transition.zig must remain pure — no I/O, no DB calls); (3) Integrate mergeVariables into the completeTask flow in instance.zig — merge happens AFTER reading the instance snapshot but BEFORE calling the transition function (so the transition sees the merged variables); (4) Emit VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN events atomically within the same DB transaction as the TASK_COMPLETED event; (5) On schema violation: emit EXECUTION_ERROR event, set instance status to ERROR, all within one transaction — do NOT apply the variable merge; (6) Empty output_variables is a no-op — no events emitted; (7) zig build and zig build test must both exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: mergeVariables function implemented with three-path collision policy
mergeVariables is NOT in transition.zig (transition.zig remains pure)
VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN events emitted atomically with task completion
Schema violation causes ERROR state + EXECUTION_ERROR event atomically
Empty output_variables causes no events and no DB writes

result.summary: Implemented EE-09 Variable Scoping and Merge: (1) mergeVariables method added to InstanceStore in src/engine/instance.zig with three-path collision policy (schema validation → SCHEMA_VIOLATION error, existing key → VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event, new key → insert); (2) completeTask restructured so BEGIN transaction happens before mergeVariables, enabling atomic commit of TASK_COMPLETED + VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN events; (3) schema violation path emits EXECUTION_ERROR event, sets instance status=ERROR with error_detail, and commits atomically; (4) minimal JSON Schema validator created in src/tools/json_schema.zig covering type/minimum/maximum/maxLength/enum keywords; (5) SchemaViolationError added to CompleteTaskError and handled in tasks route with HTTP 422.
